verdict.rationale: Individual SKILL.md files (tdd, triage, grilling, setup) and the aihero.dev catalog give short one-line descriptions of what each skill does, and some (e.g. tdd, grilling, triage) spell out concrete behavioral triggers like 'write the failing test first' or 'interview the user relentlessly,' which lets a developer roughly predict behavior; the verified runtime install also shows real SKILL.md frontmatter with a name field. However there's no systematic 'when it activates' metadata (e.g. explicit trigger conditions/auto-invocation rules) documented across the whole skill set, and a community reviewer flagged that some skill prose 'has little utility' and even contradicts its own claims (jargon example), undercutting confidence that documentation reliably predicts behavior. missing for 10: explicit per-skill activation-trigger specs beyond a few flagship skills, and independent corroboration that docs match real agent behavior across the full catalog.
